title: GFM Block Tokenizer & Preview Model (Headings, Task Lists, Code Fences, Blockquotes)
acceptanceCriteria: Implement rust/crates/marktext-core/src/markdown_blocks.rs to match tools/migration-sdk/src/legacy/markdown-blocks.ts exactly on every file in evals/corpus/.
Support block kinds: heading (level 1-6), code_fence (lang, code), task_item (checked, text), blockquote (text), hr, and paragraph (text).
Wire the migrated Rust block renderer into marktext-gpui when the markdown-blocks flag is migrated, while preserving legacy fallback.
Enable markdown-blocks in config/migration-flags/dev.json ONLY (never touch prod.json).
Add Rust unit tests and a headless GPUI test verifying block rendering.
